title: What happens when the first choice sells out?
description: Try the requested headphones, then handle a stock obstacle within the same action budget.
observation: Profile A (Exhaustive exploration): all mission requirements verified. 8 actions recorded. Profile B (Targeted verification): all mission requirements verified. 8 actions recorded.
mission: Try Cloud Nine first. Order exactly one pair of over-ear headphones with active noise cancellation and at least 30 hours of battery. Spend at most $120 including delivery, with no optional extras. If the requested pair is unavailable, choose an eligible alternative.
strategySummaries: Compare available options before committing; recover if stock changes.
Narrow candidates first, then verify a qualifying alternative.
comparisonPurpose: Compare broad exploration with targeted verification after the requested product becomes unavailable. The task tests recovery while preserving product requirements and the delivered-price budget.

config.name: Exhaustive exploration
config.instructions: Compare all available options before committing. Inspect each candidate’s detailed facts to establish which best fits the mission, then buy a qualifying option. Follow the requested purchase sequence and recover from availability errors.
